d:
Jharkhand ke mahan svatantrata aur adhikaron ke sangharsh ke pratik shahid sobran manjhi ka 69van shahadat divas 27 navanbar ko ramgarh jile ke nemra sthit lukaeeyatand maidan men manaya gaya. is mauke par mukhyamantri hemant soren aur vidhayak kalpana soren ne shahid sobran manjhi ki aadamkad pratima par malyarpan kar shraddhanjli arpit ki.
Shahid sobran manjhi ne mahajni pratha aur shoshan ke khilaph aavaj uthaee thi. aadivasiyon aur garib kisanon ko unke adhikaron ke prati jagruk karne ke sangharsh men 27 navanbar 1957 ko unki hatya kar di gaee thi.
